q: Why are browser agents especially exposed to prompt injection?
options: Every page they read is untrusted content that may contain instructions

q: When should you prefer an API or MCP server over computer use?
options: Whenever one exists for the task
explain: Computer use is slower and less reliable.

q: Why run computer-use agents in an isolated browser profile?
options: Your everyday profile has logged-in sessions that injected instructions could abuse

q: What advantage does acting on an accessibility tree have over screenshots?
options: Fewer tokens and precise element references instead of pixel coordinates
explain: Structure is precise where it exists.
